paite: Huan kha in ahon domkang a, TOUPA' inn suahlam lutna, suahlam muhna ahon tun a; ngai in, lutna kongkhak chin ah mi sawmnih-le-nga ana om ua; alak uah Azzur tapa Jaazaniah leh Benaiah tapa Pelatiah, mipi heutute ka mu hi.
heading: Jerusalem Mohpaih In A-om

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiaite gitlouhna sawmkhete ahi ua, hiai khopi a gitlouh sawmkhe mite ahi uh.
Inn lam hun ahi nai kei; hiai khopi sa uina bel ahi a, eite asa i hi uh," chite.
"Huaiziak in thu gen inla, aw mihing tapa, atung uah thu gen in," achi hi.
Huan ka tung ah TOUPA kha ahong tung a, ama'n ka kiang ah, "Gen in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hichibang in na hihsek ua, aw Israel inkote aw, na lungsim ua thil hong tungte ka theisiang vek hi.
Hiai khopi ah na mithahte uh na pungsak huthut ua, akongzingte na mithah un na dimsakta uhi."
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Na mithah uh alai a na koihte uh asa ahi ua; hiai khopi ahihleh sa uina bel ahi, himahleh alai a kipan suankhiak in na om ding uhi.
Namsau na kihta ua, na tung uah namsau ka hon tun ding, Toupa PATHIAN in achi.
"Alai a kipan ka hon pawtkhesak ding a, namdangte khut ah ka hon mansak ding a, na tungthu uh angaihtuah ding uh.
Namsau in na si ding ua, Israel gamgi lam ah na tungthu uh ka ngaihtuah ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
Hiai khopi na sa uina bel uh ahi kei ding a, nou asung a sa na hi sam kei ding ua, Israel gamgi lam ah na tungthu uh ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
Huan TOUPA ka hi chih na theita ding uh, ka dan bawl na zui kei ua, ka thupawt leng na zui sam kei ua; na kim ua namte hihdan na zui zawta uh, achi," chi in.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, thu ka genleh Benaiah tapa Pelatiah ana sita mai a, huchi in ka khuppuk a, aw ngaihtak a kikou in, "Ah, Toupa PATHIAN, Israel khosuaksunte chimihna na bawl ding a hia?" ka chi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kiang ah,
heading: Saltangte Kiang A Pathian Thuchiam

paite: "Mihing tapa, na unaute, na chi-le-kuangte ngei leh Israel inkote tengteng, avek un, Jerusalem luah mite'n TOUPA a kipan paimang un, hiai gam kou a dia piak ahita hi," achihnate uh ahi uhi.

Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Gamlapi ah namte lak ah ka suanmang a, gam tampi ah ka hihdalh na a, sawt lou kal in ava tunna gam uah amaute a ding in Mun Siangthou ka hi ding," achi hi.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Namdangte a kipan in ka hon pikhawm nawn ding a, na dalhna gam ua kipan ka hon kaikhawm nawn ding a, Israel gam ka hon pe ding hi.
Huchi in huai ah ahong pai ding ua, thil huathuai tengteng leh thilkihhuaite a kipan alamang ding uhi.
Lungtang khat ka pe ding a, na sung uah lungsim thak ka koih ding. Huan asa ua kipan lungtangsak ka lamang ding a, akiang uah lungtang nem ka pe ding hi.
Ka dan thusehte azuih ua, ka thupiakte avom ua, ahihtheihna ding un, huchi in ka mite ahi ding ua, kei leng a Pathian uh ka hi ding.
Ahuathuaina uleh akihhuaina laigil lungtang zuite bel akhelhna uh avek in amau ka khusak ding, Toupa PATHIAN in achi.
Huchi in cherubte'n akhate uh azak ua, akiang uah kangtalai liimte a-om a, atung uah Israel' Pathian thupina a-om hi.
heading: Pathian Thupina In Jerusalem Anusia

paite: Khopi lai a kipan in TOUPA thupina apaitou a, khopi suahlam pang a tang sang ah ava dinghta hi.
Huan kha in ahon domkang a, kilakna ah Pathian kha in Kaldai gam a saltangte kiang ah ahon tun hi. Huchi in ka kilakna muh in ahon paitouhsanta hi.
Huchi in saltangte kiang ah TOUPA'N thil ahon etsak tengteng ka genta hi.
